data.title: Aurania Announces Termination of Private Placement, Loan Agreement and Proposed Warrant Extension
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Aurania Resources Ltd. (OTCQB: AUIAF) (FSE: 20Q) ("Aurania" or the "Company") announces that it has (i) terminated its previously announced private placement, (ii) entered into a loan agreement with its Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, Dr. Keith Barron, and (iii) intends to extend the term of certain outstanding common share purchase warrants.

The Company has terminated its non-brokered private placement as announced by the Company on November 19, 2026, due to current market conditions.

Dr. Keith Barron has agreed to provide a loan of up to US$1,500,000 to the Company to be advanced from time to time in principal amounts as agreed by the parties (the "Loan"). The Loan is unsecured, bears interest at 2% per annum and matures twelve months and one day after demand for repayment is given by the Lender, which may be provided at any time following the date hereof. The proceeds of the Loan will be used for exploration expenses and general working capital.

Dr. Keith Barron is a related party of the Company by virtue of the fact that he is Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, a promoter and a principal shareholder of the Company, and as a result, each advance and repayment under the Loan constitutes a "Related Party Transaction" for the purposes of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101"). The Company is relying upon an exemption from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements under MI 61-101 in respect of the Related Party Transaction, in reliance on Sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1) of MI 61-101, respectively, as the fair market value of the Related Party Transaction, collectively, does not exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101. The Company did not file a material change report related to the Loan more than 21 days before the expected closing of the Loan as required by MI 61-101, as the Company wished to organize the Loan on an expedited basis for sound business reasons.

The Company further announces that it has applied to the TSX Venture Exchange (the "TSXV") to extend the expiry date of an aggregate of 3,747,243 common share purchase warrants of the Company (the "Warrants") issued pursuant to a non-brokered private placement of the Company (the "Offering"), which closed in tranches on December 13, 2024, and December 23, 2024. Each Warrant is exercisable at a price of C$0.75, with 2,726,499 Warrants expiring on December 13, 2026, and 1,020,744 Warrants expiring on December 23, 2026. The Company intends to extend the expiry date for these Warrants by 12 months to December 13, 2027, and December 23, 2027, respectively for each tranche of Warrants. All other terms and conditions of the Warrants will remain unchanged. The extension of the expiry date of the Warrants is subject to the acceptance of the TSXV.

Dr. Keith Barron participated in the Offering (subscribing through Bambazonke Holdings Ltd., a wholly-owned company of Dr. Barron) and accordingly was issued 888,889 of the Warrants, all of which Dr. Barron continues to hold (the "Insider Warrants"). Dr. Barron's ownership of the Insider Warrants renders the Warrant expiry date extension a "related party transaction" within the meaning of MI 61-101. However, the extension is exempt from the requirements of Part 5 of MI 61-101 pursuant to Sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1) of MI 61-101 as the fair market value of Dr. Keith Barron's interest in the extension does not exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101.

The Loan and the Warrant extension were approved by the members of the board of directors of the Company who are independent for purposes of the related party transactions, being all directors other than Dr. Barron. No special committee was established in connection with the Loan or Warrant extension, and no materially contrary view or abstention was expressed or made by any director of the Company in relation thereto.

About Aurania

Aurania is a mineral exploration company engaged in the identification, evaluation, acquisition, and exploration of mineral property interests, with a focus on precious metals and critical energy in Europe and abroad.

Information on Aurania and technical reports are available at www.aurania.com and www.sedarplus.ca, as well as on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/auranialtd/, Twitter at https://twitter.com/auranialtd, and LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/company/aurania-resources-ltd-.

data.title: Canada Climate Week Xchange Closes the Market
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Canada Climate Week Xchange (CCWX) event hosts and honoured guests, joined Eliza Riego, Managing Director, Product Innovation and ESG Strategy, Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX), to close the market in celebration of CCWX 2026.

Co-founded by TSX, alongside five other national organizations, CCWX demonstrates how market infrastructure providers can mobilize capital markets to tackle climate challenges. Given TSX's central position within Canada's capital markets, stock exchanges are uniquely positioned to foster broad stakeholder engagement, and advance a national conversation on climate-aligned action and initiatives.

CCWX follows a decentralized model, where events are hosted by a variety of organizations, with formats ranging from in-person to virtual, a feature that maximizes accessibility for Canadians. Climate events this week included multiple panel discussions at the TMX Market Centre today, discussing public and private climate initiatives and implications for the insurance and mining sectors.

data.title: Eshbal Reports Nine-Month 2026 Revenue of US$12.1 Million, Up 19.5% Year-Over-Year
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Eshbal Functional Food Inc. ("Eshbal" or the "Company") reports its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. All amounts are in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated.

Cannot view this image? Visit:

https://images.newsfilecorp.com/files/12370/326023_ef8ef79ef4aaa91f_logo.jpg

Eshbal reported revenue of US$12.07 million for the first nine months of 2026, an increase of 19.5% compared with US$10.10 million for the same period in 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, revenue was US$3.31 million, compared with US$3.38 million in Q3 2025.

The year-over-year comparison reflects the continued evolution of Eshbal following completion of its reverse takeover in April 2025. Accordingly, the first four months of the 2025 comparative period primarily reflected Eshbal's operations prior to completion of the RTO and did not include the Company's current public-company cost structure and the launch of its North American operations.

Financial Highlights

  • Nine-month revenue of US$12.07 million, up 19.5% from US$10.10 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
  • Third-quarter revenue of US$3.31 million, compared to US$3.38 million for the third quarter of 2025.
  • Gross margin of 21.5% for the nine months (16.0% for the third quarter), compared to 26.9% (29.5%) for the comparable periods of 2025, mainly reflecting changes in product mix and lower sales in Israel.
  • Third-quarter net loss of US$0.94 million, compared to US$0.51 million for the third quarter of 2025.
  • Net loss for the nine months of US$1.66 million, compared to US$2.11 million for the comparable period.
  • Total assets of US$14.21 million as at September 30, 2026, compared to US$12.24 million as at December 31, 2025.

Operational Highlights

  • North America: In September 2026, Eshbal USA, which includes the Gluten Free Nation business, participated in the ECRM trade show, meeting with approximately 40 potential retail and foodservice customers. Following the show, the Company sent product samples to approximately 20 prospective customers and is in follow-up discussions with them.
  • Gluten-free Pita: The Company continued supplying its gluten-free Pita products from its Ontario manufacturing partners and continued discussions with leading Canadian retailers.
  • Product development: The Company developed initial samples of a powdered protein shake product designed for GLP-1 medication users.

"Over the past nine months, our focus has been on integrating our recently acquired businesses, addressing operational and commercial challenges, strengthening relationships with suppliers and customers, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and create synergies across the Group," said Tomer Bar Meir, Chief Executive Officer of Eshbal. "While these efforts take time to translate into financial results, we expect to see the benefits of this work increasingly reflected in our performance during 2027."

Board Update

The Company also announces that Nir Peles has been appointed Vice-Chair of the Board of Directors and a member of the Audit Committee, replacing Yuval Levy on the Audit Committee. The Audit Committee is now composed of Sokhie Puar (Chair), Tamir Dagan, Ifti Ifhar and Nir Peles.

"I am pleased to take on the role of Vice-Chair and to join the Audit Committee," said Nir Peles. "I look forward to working with the Board and management to support Eshbal's continued growth."

The Company's condensed interim consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 are available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

About Eshbal Group

Eshbal Group is an international food group focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing better-for-you, gluten-free, GLP-1 friendly food products and dietary supplements. Built on more than three decades of industry experience, the Group combines product innovation, manufacturing expertise, and commercial expertise to develop and grow a portfolio of innovative health and wellness brands. The Group's strategy is to build a leading platform of health and wellness brands through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, operational excellence, and international expansion.

data.title: CF Energy Announces Financial Results For the Three-Month and Nine-Month Periods Ended September 30, 2026
data.description:
TORONTO, ON / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / CF Energy Corp. ("CF Energy" or the "Company", together with its subsidiaries, the "Group"), an energy provider in the People's Republic of China (the "PRC" or "China"), announces that the Company has filed its unaudited interim consolidated financial results for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026.

The unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis ("MD&A") can be downloaded from www.sedarplus.com or from the Company's website at www.cfenergy.com.

The unaudited interim consolidated financial statements have been prepared in conformity with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board ("IASB") (collectively, "IFRS Accounting Standards"). This news release contains financial terms that are non-IFRS Accounting Standards ("non-GAAP") financial measures.

Results for the three-month period ended September 30, 2026 ("Q3 2026")

Continuing Operations

Gross Profit Margin 29.9% 31.0%-1.1%
Net Profit 3.2 3.8 (0.6) -17% 0.6 0.7 (0.1)

Revenue in Q3 2026 was RMB103.5 million (approx. CAD21.0 million), an increase of RMB14.9 million (approx. CAD3.8 million), or 17%, from RMB88.6 million (approx. CAD17.2 million) for the three months ended September 30, 2025 ("Q3 2025").

The increase in overall revenue in Q3 2026 was mainly attributed to the increase in revenue from residential customers of gas distribution utility sector. The positive effect of Hainan Free Port's opening-up policy continued to lead to an increase in both sales volume of gas supply to residential customers and the pipeline installation and connection revenue from residential customers since the first quarter of 2026 which carried through to Q3 2026.

The increase in installation pipeline revenue for new customers of the Haitang Bay Smart Energy project in the integrated smart energy segment also contributed to the increase in revenue in Q3 2026.

Gross profit in Q3 2026 was RMB30.9 million (approx. CAD6.3 million), an increase of RMB3.5 million (CAD1.0 million) or 13% from RMB27.4 million (approx. CAD5.3 million) in Q3 2025. Overall gross margin in Q3 2026 was 29.9%, a decrease of 1.1 percentage points from 31.0% in Q3 2025.

The overall decrease in gross profit margin in Q3 2026 as compared to Q3 2025 was mainly attributable to the offsetting effect of the benefit of reducing costs due to the centralization of procurement of materials for pipeline installation connection projects and the increase in unit price of pipeline installation and connection for residential customers by providing auxiliary services at minimal cost which partially offset the overall increase in material cost and labor cost since late December 2025, together with the increase of 3% in the purchase price of pipeline gas as compared to Q3 2025.

Net profit in Q3 2026 was RMB3.2 million (approx. CAD0.6 million), a decrease of RMB0.6 million (CAD0.1 million) or 17% from RMB3.8 million (approx. CAD0.7 million) in Q3 2025.

EBITDA (non-GAAP) in Q3 2026 was RMB22.2 million (approx. CAD4.5 million), a decrease of RMB1.0 million (approx. CAD0.0 million), or 4%, from RMB23.2 million (approx. CAD4.5 million) in Q3 2025.

Both basic and diluted earnings per share ("EPS") in Q3 2026 from continuing operations was RMB0.08 (CAD0.02) per share, an increase of RMB0.01 (CAD0.01), as compared to RMB0.07 CAD0.01) per share in Q3 2025.

Revenue for the Nine Months in 2026 was RMB322.6 million (approx. CAD65.5 million), an increase of RMB30.6 million (approx. CAD8.9 million), or 10%, from RMB292.0 million (approx. CAD56.6 million) for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 (the "Nine Months in 2025").

The increase in overall revenue for the Nine Months in 2026 was attributed to the increase in revenue in Q3 2026 as mentioned above but offset by the decrease in the EV battery swap revenue in the smart mobility segment which was caused by a trend in switching of travel habits by tourists from taking taxis to renting Uber services when travelling in the Sanya City.

Gross profit for the Nine Months in 2026 was RMB87.2 million (approx. CAD17.7 million), an increase of RMB9.6 million (CAD2.7 million) or 12% from RMB77.6 million (approx. CAD15.0 million) for the Nine Months in 2025. Overall gross margin for the Nine Months in 2026 was 27.0%, an increase of 0.4 percentage points from 26.6% for the Nine Months in 2025.

A non-recurring urban gas pipeline facility renovation projects in 2024-2025 were agreed at relatively competitive prices with very low gross margin which had a dilutive effect on the overall gross profit and margin for the Nine Months in 2025. Excluding this dilutive effect, the gross profit margin for the Nine Months in 2026 and 2025 remained the same at 27.0% on a comparable basis.

Net profit for the Nine Months in 2026 was RMB8.8 million (approx. CAD1.8 million), an increase of RMB2.4 million (CAD0.6 million) or 37% from RMB6.4 million (approx. CAD1.2 million) for the Nine Months in 2025.

EBITDA (non-GAAP) for the Nine Months in 2026 was RMB65.5 million (approx. CAD13.3 million), a decrease of RMB0.7 million (approx. CAD0.5 million), or 1%, from RMB66.2 million (approx. CAD12.8 million) for the Nine Months in 2025.

Both basic and diluted earnings per share ("EPS") from continuing operations was RMB0.20 (CAD0.04) per share for the Nine Months in 2026, an increase of RMB0.04 (CAD0.01) as compared to RMB0.16 (CAD0.03) per share for the Nine Months in 2025.

Company Outlook

The global energy landscape is undergoing a fundamental transformation with accelerating efforts in electrification and digitalization of the industry. In the short-term, the global energy markets will remain volatile due to geopolitical uncertainties and supply chain disruptions while demand for electricity consumption continues to rise driven by the rapid growth of data centers, artificial intelligence applications and etc. The natural gas industry faces a variety of challenges ranging from regulatory impacts to market dynamics, but it continues to play a critical role as a transition fuel, supporting the integration of renewable energy, distributed energy resources, and digital energy management systems as they are becoming key components of modern energy infrastructure.

At the same time, the continued development of the Hainan Free Trade Port has significantly enhanced the economic vitality of the region, particularly in Sanya. The increase in tourism and commercial activity has driven higher for energy consumption, which also led to steady growth in the Company's natural gas supply business. The Company envisions that Sanya will expand its infrastructure including hospitality, retail, and transportation which will create additional opportunities for energy consumption and integrated energy services.

Distributed Smart Energy Ecosystem - Progress to Date:

CF Energy has continued its strategic transformation from a traditional natural gas company into a comprehensive energy solutions provider, focusing on incorporating its smart energy system and energy storage technology to create a highly integrated and efficient framework for sustainable energy management.

CF Energy's Haitang Bay integrated smart energy project and Meishan project are flagships of standalone distributed energy system with advanced grid technologies that enable real-time monitoring and responsive energy distribution based on demand and supply conditions. The Haitang Bay integrated smart energy system has enhanced energy efficiency and system flexibility through the application of ice storage for peak load shifting.

In parallel, the Company has entered the field of electrochemical energy storage for cost reduction and energy conservation through the mode of battery swapping in new energy vehicles. The battery swap station network in Sanya and Beihai have been contributing to the optimization of the power grid as they reduce strain on the electrical grid and avoid demand spikes.

Distributed Smart Energy Ecosystem -Current Initiatives:

The Company is working with partners in the IoT (internet of things), and cloud services field to create an efficient EMS (energy management system) that connects the standalone distributed smart energy systems with various energy management and storage technologies. This will serve as the core infrastructure for enabling virtual power plant (VPP) capabilities. Through the deployment of IoT-enabled devices and data acquisition systems, the Company will be able to collect real-time data on energy production, storage levels, battery health, and consumption patterns. Using historical data and machine learning models, the EMS can predict demand spikes, potential system disruptions, and optimal energy production schedules. This will form the operational backbone of the Company's virtual power plant strategy.

Distributed Smart Energy Ecosystem - Outlook and Strategic Direction:

The Company will continue its development in energy management driven by electrification, increasing renewable penetration, and rising demand for power grid stability. The Company aims to aggregate and optimize the distributed energy assets including centralized cooling system, battery swap stations, and energy storage system into a platform which enables the development of virtual power plant with active end user participation. This will provide support in power grid stability via peak shaving, load balancing, and frequency regulation.

In addition, the Company is working to integrate a demand response system where hotels and other end users can opt-in to adjust their energy usage during peak periods in response to incentives. For example, shifting non-essential power usage to off-peak hours. EV owners can charge their vehicles during off-peak hours to benefit from lower rates and reduce grid strain during high-demand periods. Alternatively, V2G (Vehicle to Grid) concept allows EVs to return energy to the grid during peak times, effectively using the vehicle's battery as a grid resource. Furthermore, utilizing a platform for energy trading that allows surplus energy (from renewable sources and stored energy) to be sold back to the grid or shared among participants will add additional revenue stream and encouraging sustainable practices. The integration must connect all components through a smart grid that enables two-way communication between the energy providers and consumers.

About CF Energy Corp. (Previously known as: Changfeng Energy Inc.)

CF Energy Corp. is a Canadian public company currently traded on the Toronto Venture Exchange ("TSX-V") under the stock symbol "CFY". It is an integrated energy provider and natural gas distribution company (or natural gas utility) in the PRC. CF Energy strives to combine leading clean energy technology with natural gas usage to provide sustainable energy to its customer base in the PRC.

data.title: QBE Insurance books upbeat nine-month premium, retains annual outlook
data.description:
QBE Insurance Group posted a rise in nine-month premium on Friday, as Australia's largest insurer by market value benefited from strong performances across various portfolios in the Northern Hemisphere.

  • Gross written premiums rose 9% on a reported basis to $20.3 billion for the nine months ended September 30

  • QBE's group premium rate — the average change in insurance premium rates across its global portfolio — was broadly flat over the period, consistent with its first-half pace

  • Net catastrophe claims totaled roughly $700 million for the 10 months to October, which includes an allowance of around $150 million for costs associated with the Middle East conflict

  • Total investment funds under management as of September 30 stood at $37.1 billion, higher than $36.6 billion on June 30, 2026

  • QBE said that it continues to expect a combined operating ratio, which measures underwriting profitability, of about 92.5% for financial year 2026, alongside GWP growth in the mid-single digits on a constant-currency basis

data.title: Spain's Pablo Hernández De Cos To Be Next ECB Chief
data.description:
BRUSSELS/FRANKFURT/PARIS (dpa-AFX) - Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos is set to succeed Christine Lagarde as the European Central Bank president when the latter steps down in February next year.

He would be the first Spaniard to be at the helm of the central bank for the single-currency bloc.

The euro area member states agreed to recommend de Cos as the ECB chief and France's Laurence Boone and Germany's Markus Brunnermeier as ECB Executive Board members, European Council President António Costa said in a post on the social media platform X on Thursday.

The former Bank of Spain governor's appointment to the top post of one of the major central banks in the world, awaits formal approval following a European Council meeting in December. His only rival in the race to be the ECB chief was the former Dutch central bank governor Klass Knot.

The Spanish economist has been the general manager at the Basel, Switzerland-based Bank of International Settlements since July 2025. He was the governor of the Bank of Spain, an institution he served since 1997, and a member of the ECB Governing Council from 2018 to 2024.

Late October, the current ECB President Lagarde announced her decision to step down from her post on February 07, 2027, roughly nine months ahead of the expiry of her eight-year term. She is leaving the job in search of a larger freedom to express her political views.

Brunnermeier is set to replace Philip Lane as the ECB chief economist and Boone will replace Isabel Schnabel who is now in charge of the market operations, when their terms end in May and January, respectively.

De Cos, with a strong background in monetary policy and central banking, is widely known to be moderately dovish in his stance as shown by his actions in the past. His appointment comes at a crucial time for the Eurozone economy as it battles high inflation that is much beyond the 2 percent target and turmoil in the debt market due to rising bond yields, in particular for France.

The ECB is widely expected to raise interest rates further in December as inflation hit a three-year high of 4.0 percent in October and is expected to remain strong in November driven by surging energy prices.
